name: matrix-spinner
description: A matrix-style scrambling spinner for Claude Code with a gleam, a live readout and an ephemeral verb the model can set, ported from the spinner in charmbracelet/mods.

longThinkSeconds.title: Long think (seconds)
longThinkSeconds.description: A single stretch of thinking this long lets the model pick one fresh verb for the rest of the turn. 0 turns it off.
